name: Marble Claw
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (Orlassk's choice). If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 19). Orlassk can grapple up to two targets, one with each claw.
